title: Lost hiker meets a woman who went missing a decade earlier
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Lost hiker meets a woman who went missing a decade earlier, about unspecified at forest (US), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The description fits to someone who went lost went missing there like a decade or more ago

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, relays a story he credits to a man he calls David Pitus and to Missing 411, a series of books about strange disappearances in the wild. As Jorjani tells it, a hiker lost in a US forest met a woman whose description fit someone who had gone missing in that same place a decade or more earlier. If true, it would hint that missing people can turn up somewhere outside normal time.
